# arin_irr_route (Resource)

Manage a simple IPv4 or IPv6 ARIN IRR route. Prefix and origin ASN identify the object; changing either requires replacement. Owns description and remarks. POC links and network handle are generated by ARIN. Advanced RPSL routes, memberOf associations, and ROA-linked routes are not supported. Removing the resource deletes the route. Import existing routes by prefix and origin ASN separated by a comma.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Substitute prefixes registered to your organization; evaluate writes in OT&E.
resource "arin_irr_route" "example" {
  prefix      = "192.0.2.0/24"
  origin_as   = "AS64496"
  org_handle  = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description = ["Example IPv4 route"]
  remarks     = ["Managed with Terraform"]
}

resource "arin_irr_route" "example_v6" {
  prefix      = "2001:db8::/48"
  origin_as   = "AS64496"
  org_handle  = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description = ["Example IPv6 route"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `org_handle` (String) Uppercase maintaining organization handle. Changing it replaces the object.
- `origin_as` (String) Canonical origin ASN, such as AS64496. Changes require replacement.
- `prefix` (String) Canonical IPv4 or IPv6 network CIDR. Host bits must be zero. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) Canonical prefix and origin ASN separated by a comma, for example 192.0.2.0/24,AS64496. Also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `net_handle` (String) Network registration handle assigned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the IRR route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import existing simple routes using their canonical prefix and origin ASN.
terraform import arin_irr_route.example '192.0.2.0/24,AS64496'
terraform import arin_irr_route.example_v6 '2001:db8::/48,AS64496'
```
